subject.title: fix(agents): log Anthropic provider rejections with status, redacted detail, and payload stats

question: Should provider-returned rejection detail be persisted in default warning logs, or only under explicit diagnostic/debug logging because it may echo non-secret request content?
rationale: Pattern-based secret redaction cannot establish that arbitrary provider-returned text is safe for routine persistent logs, so the permanent log-data boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Gate detail behind debug
options.body: Keep structural diagnostics at warn while emitting provider-returned detail only when explicit diagnostic logging is enabled.

options.title: Accept bounded detail at warn
options.body: Deliberately allow capped provider-returned text in routine persistent logs and document the privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Gate detail behind debug
recommendation.body: Keep structural diagnostics at warn while emitting provider-returned detail only when explicit diagnostic logging is enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: He most directly owns the current Anthropic transport seam and sibling transport logging convention.
